I am in Lindi, and on this maize plot I usually manage with what my household can afford and the labor we have. Our soils are not very strong, and I intercrop, so I will use some manure if I can get it, but chemical fertilizer is costly so I will only use a modest amount. I will plant improved seed to get a better stand, but I do not expect to irrigate because we depend on the rains. I may use a little herbicide or pesticide if needed, and I will still need some hired labor for land preparation and weeding.
